description: Reads the signed-in account id and access token from chatgpt.com. The response shape is validated before any archive request runs; a changed shape fails the run.
observation_recipe: open https://chatgpt.com/ while signed in and record GET /api/auth/session
sign out and confirm the same request no longer returns an account id and access token
verification_cases: identity: account id matches the browser session
signed out: a missing user or token stops the run with a sign-in message
shape drift: a changed response fails before any conversation is fetched
account change: a different account id stops the run when expectedAccountId is set
expired token: a 401 retries once with a freshly read session
